body.x: Sorcerics (CEO Hyeonjong Ryu) participated in CES 2026 Unveiled, held on January 4 (local time) in Las Vegas, the United States.

Founded in 2023, Sorcerics is a Korean startup developing AI-based ambient computing technologies. By applying and advancing intelligent IoT (AIoT) technologies that recognize spaces, people, and contextual information in real time, the company introduces next-generation smart home technologies that automatically deliver optimal services without explicit user commands.

After building a technology-driven growth structure through early seed investment and patent acquisition, Sorcerics recently strengthened its connection to the global technology ecosystem by being selected for the NVIDIA Inception Program. Based on these achievements and the company’s growth momentum, it explained that it is positioning itself as a provider of new user experiences in the smart home solutions market.

At the Unveiled event, Sorcerics revealed its flagship product, ‘SOL,’ which represents the company’s AI capabilities. SOL is a device that integrates cameras, sensors, and AI algorithms to capture residents’ indoor movements, patterns, and context, as well as environmental factors such as lighting conditions.

Data collected through the device is analyzed by built-in AI algorithms, which then automatically control smart home appliances such as lighting and HVAC systems. The core concept of SOL is to optimize the living environment naturally, without requiring users to issue voice commands or operate mobile applications.

body.cap: A Sorcerics official (right) introduces the company’s products and technology to overseas media at CES 2026 Unveiled | Photo by AVING News

body.x: To achieve this, Sorcerics enhanced SOL’s real-time situational awareness using proprietary spatial recognition algorithms, significantly reducing the operational inconvenience and configuration complexity that have been cited as drawbacks of conventional smart home products. In addition, SOL’s clear differentiation helped the company secure a CES 2026 Innovation Award in the Home Alliances category, amplifying global interest in its product and technology even before the exhibition officially opened.

Sorcerics is continuing to develop SOL while advancing its IoT, signal processing, and AI technologies in a comprehensive manner. Through this, the company aims to implement deeper spatial understanding capabilities and automated scenario generation functions, accelerating the deployment of its solutions across areas such as smart living, senior care, and premium residential services.

A Sorcerics official said, “We are pleased to have had the opportunity to directly verify the global market suitability of the ambient computing technology we have been developing,” adding, “Global media, technology companies, and buyers showed strong interest in our ‘command-free smart home automation’ technology, confirming that SOL has sufficient competitiveness not only in Korea but also in overseas markets.”

Meanwhile, the company will also participate in the main CES 2026 exhibition, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-dedicated exhibition zone. The CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion, led by the Seoul Business Agency (SBA), brings together 19 startup support organizations in Seoul, including district offices, related institutions, and universities, to support 70 startups. The participating companies span advanced technology fields such as AI, mobility, and healthcare, and selected outstanding firms receive opportunities to participate in the official CES media event, CES Unveiled.

‘CES Unveiled’ is a key official event held ahead of the CES opening, bringing together Innovation Award winners and companies showcasing innovative, cutting-edge products. The event brings together global media, company executives, government officials, and major technology industry stakeholders in one place.
